questions.prompt: DCCC (a party committee) has spent $281K in OH's 13th District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Democrat or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: In the final 20 days, a campaign gets a $2,000 check. What must it do?
questions.why: Contributions of $1,000 or more received in the last 20 days must be reported within 48 hours on Form 6.

questions.prompt: In TX's 34th District House race, outside money favors Republicans by $1.9M. Whose nominee has raised more?
questions.why: Outside money and candidate money point opposite ways here: the Democrat leads fundraising by $1.3M.

questions.prompt: How often do House and Senate campaigns file their regular reports in an election year?
questions.why: Candidate committees file quarterly, plus 12 days before and 30 days after each election. Monthly filing is only an option for PACs and parties.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $816K in the MT Senate race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is offense.

questions.prompt: Can a corporation give unlimited money to a super PAC?
